note: The closed move set of rulebook/19_NARRATIVE_LAYER.md. A move is a trigger plus a banded outcome; it adds no dice, no modifier and no currency. Outcomes are read off the core total with src/rules/narrative_layer.band_for().

moves.name: Read a situation
moves.trigger: You take a moment to look at a place — a room, a street, a terminal — and ask what is really going on.

outcomes.miss: You draw attention, and the situation answers: someone notices you noticing.
outcomes.cost: Ask one question from the list; the answer costs you something (time, cover, a favour).
outcomes.clean: Ask three questions from the list.
outcomes.style: Ask three questions, and take an aspect from what you found.

moves.name: Read a person
moves.trigger: You watch someone under pressure and want to know what they are actually doing.

outcomes.miss: They read you instead; they know what you were looking for.
outcomes.cost: Ask one question; they notice you asking, and the clock ticks.
outcomes.style: Ask two questions, and take an aspect on them.

moves.name: Apply pressure
moves.trigger: You push someone with leverage you actually hold — a debt, a threat, a favour owed.

outcomes.miss: They dig in, and now they know what you want.
outcomes.cost: They comply, and name a price: a promise, a secret, a later favour.
outcomes.style: They comply, and you keep the leverage for the next time.

moves.name: Hold steady
moves.trigger: Something you are seeing contradicts what you know to be true, and you have to keep functioning.

outcomes.miss: You hold, and it takes something with it — the mind system decides what.
outcomes.cost: You hold, visibly: your hands, your voice or your cover gives you away.
outcomes.clean: You hold, and nothing else does.
outcomes.style: You hold, and you can name the thing for what it is.

moves.name: Cross a threshold
moves.trigger: You get past a barrier that someone is actively guarding — a door, a cordon, a checkpoint, a ward.

outcomes.miss: You are stopped, and whoever stopped you now has a decision to make about you.
outcomes.cost: You are through, and it cost noise, gear or time.
outcomes.style: You are through, unnoticed, and you can bring someone with you or leave a way back.

moves.name: Set up
moves.trigger: You spend your action preparing rather than acting: laying a wire, priming a witness, staging a room.

outcomes.miss: The preparation fails in a way the opposition can see.
outcomes.cost: It works, and it is obvious that it was set up.
outcomes.clean: It works: a permission aspect, or one step on a later roll.
outcomes.style: It works, and it is invisible until it is used.

moves.name: Ground yourself
moves.trigger: You take a scene to come back to yourself — sleep, a trusted person, a hospital, a ritual.

outcomes.miss: It does not take; something else has your attention now.
outcomes.cost: You get a moment's relief, and nothing is resolved.
outcomes.style: Cancel one temporary condition, and the next one is harder to land.

moves.name: Contact the noösphere
moves.trigger: You open your mind to the Noösphere and let it answer.

outcomes.miss: Something answers that you did not ask for.
outcomes.cost: One true answer, and something else learns you were listening.
outcomes.style: Three true answers, and one of them is about you.
